name: Vinay Verma
title: Full Stack Developer
summary: Full Stack Developer with over 3 years of experience building scalable enterprise web platforms, real-time systems, and AI-integrated features using React, Angular, and Node.js.

projects.title: International School Services
points: Integrated OpenAI's GPT-4 API to power smart candidate suggestions, streamlining the hiring workflow for schools sourced through job fairs.
Built a large-scale, enterprise-level web platform for ISS, supporting 1,200+ international schools worldwide, using Angular and Express.js.
Reduced initial bundle size by 30% (2.3 MB → 1.6 MB) via lazy loading and route-level code splitting, improving load performance on low-bandwidth networks.
Architected a real-time messaging system using Socket.IO, supporting 100+ concurrent connections with low-latency delivery.
Built reusable UI components using Angular Material, with RxJS handling pagination and data streams to keep the UI consistent across features.
Implemented JWT-based authentication and role-based authorization for secure user management.
Added email OTP verification using Nodemailer during signup, providing an extra layer of protection against fraudulent account creation.

projects.title: Clearpath
points: Integrated Google OAuth 2.0 for secure, one-click user authentication, simplifying the sign-up flow.
Built the core backend architecture using Express.js and RESTful API conventions, with JWT-based session management and MongoDB Atlas as the primary database.
Optimized MongoDB connection pooling, sustaining 500 concurrent virtual users at 0% failure rate in k6 load testing.
Implemented Redis caching for frequently accessed data, reducing database load and improving API response times.
Built real-time notifications and in-app chat functionality using Socket.IO, delivering instant updates without page refreshes.
Built a GPT-4-powered chatbot for appointment scheduling, matching patient requests to available doctor slots.
